record_policy: Original paper records are reused unchanged. Their historical two-version witnesses remain true observations, not selection caps. This sidecar separately proves the stricter three-version catalog membership using complete frozen histories.
selection_population: All 1900 resolved ICLR2025 records in the existing full catalog; no fresh identity matching or version-history refresh.

selection_rule.selection: Earliest-valid greedy maximum sequence; every adjacent selected gap must strictly exceed the threshold.
